# Copilot Instructions

This repository is an introductory project. Use the following guidelines when contributing code or answering questions.

## General Guidelines

- Write clear, readable, and well-documented code.
- Follow the existing code style and conventions in the repository.
- Keep changes minimal and focused on the task at hand.
- Prefer simple solutions over complex ones.

## Pull Requests

- Provide a clear description of what the change does and why.
- Ensure all changes are tested before submitting.
- Keep pull requests small and focused on a single concern.

## Commit Messages

- Use concise, descriptive commit messages in the imperative mood (e.g., "Add feature" not "Added feature").
- Reference related issues when applicable (e.g., "Fix #42").
